family_name: Root-purpose provenance across multi-agent handoffs
definition_mechanism: Bind every delegated subtask, tool call, generated artifact, and terminal action to a signed root-purpose record, with explicit scope changes and controller identity.
primary_implementer: Agent providers, deployers, auditors, public procurers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Workflow-level global guard before consequential completion
definition_mechanism: Evaluate the cumulative plan, intermediate artifacts, recipient, scale, target, and foreseeable downstream use immediately before a consequential action is executed.
primary_implementer: Agent providers, platforms, campaigns, public deployers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Agent authorization, least privilege and action control
definition_mechanism: Express purpose, permitted tools, targets, data, spend, duration, audience, and escalation conditions as enforceable grants; require renewed confirmation for high-impact deviations.
primary_implementer: Standards bodies, agent providers, deployers, regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Tamper-evident workflow traces and election evidence preservation
definition_mechanism: Record model/version, controller, root purpose, tool permissions, consequential actions, delivery endpoints, and intervention events in privacy-preserving tamper-evident logs with legal hold and researcher-access paths.
primary_implementer: Labs, agent providers, platforms, electoral authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Longitudinal APE–MASK–manipulation evaluation suite
definition_mechanism: Run a staged evaluation from harmful-persuasion propensity and pressured deception to contextual efficacy, adaptive attacks, agent scaffolds, personalization, and 7-, 30-, and 90-day agency outcomes.
primary_implementer: Providers, AI safety institutes, accredited researchers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Manipulation capability-to-deployment decision logic
definition_mechanism: Combine validated manipulation capability, safeguard robustness, release reversibility, personalization, tool access, likely reach, and election timing into graduated obligations.
primary_implementer: AI Office, electoral authorities, safety institutes, providers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Open-weight and election-window observability
definition_mechanism: Track release dates, access modality, derivatives, safeguard state, language coverage, campaign tooling, election windows, and incident signals without publishing reproducible misuse pathways.
primary_implementer: Universities, AI safety institutes, electoral networks, repositories
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Official-source grounding for verifiable election-administration facts
definition_mechanism: Ground answers about registration, eligibility, polling places, voting procedures and certified results in current authoritative election sources, with citations and escalation when sources conflict.
primary_implementer: Election authorities, assistants, search and social platforms
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: GPAI harmful-manipulation systemic-risk governance
definition_mechanism: Require identification and assessment of persuasion, deception and personalised targeting in multi-turn, high-stakes contexts
primary_implementer: AI Office and GPAI systemic-risk providers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: APE-style harmful-persuasion propensity diagnostic — not a release gate
definition_mechanism: Test whether a model attempts persuasion on harmful and election-relevant objectives across direct, indirect and multi-turn prompts
primary_implementer: model providers, independent evaluators and AI safety institutes
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Context-specific manipulation efficacy evaluation
definition_mechanism: Measure both manipulative tactics and actual belief or behaviour change in controlled high-stakes interactions across locales
primary_implementer: providers, regulators and accredited research institutions
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: MASK-style honesty and pressured-deception diagnostic — not a manipulation gate
definition_mechanism: Test whether a model knowingly contradicts its represented beliefs when instructed, incentivised or pressured to deceive
primary_implementer: providers and independent evaluators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Adaptive jailbreak, fine-tuning and abliteration robustness testing
definition_mechanism: Evaluate mitigations under adaptive prompting, safety-removal fine-tunes, altered system prompts, scaffolds and abliterated checkpoints
primary_implementer: providers, external red teams and regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Agent-scaffold and tool-access evaluation
definition_mechanism: Test models with realistic memory, browsing, tools, parallelism, long horizons and campaign-like scaffolding
primary_implementer: providers, NIST or AISI and independent evaluators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Pre-release safety case and Safety and Security Model Report
definition_mechanism: For signatories, document systemic-risk reasoning in the Safety and Security Model Report; a regulator-filed pre-release safety case or release condition is a further proposal.
primary_implementer: systemic-risk GPAI provider and AI Office
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Continuous post-deployment re-evaluation
definition_mechanism: Repeat risk assessment after post-training, new tools, higher inference compute, new integrations, incidents or observed drift
primary_implementer: providers, deployers and regulator
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Serious-incident reporting plus a proposed manipulation near-miss register
definition_mechanism: Report serious incidents under the binding AI Act duty; separately pilot protected reporting of manipulation near misses, safeguard bypass and deceptive agent behaviour.
primary_implementer: providers, deployers, AI Office and national authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Independent systemic-risk executive and board accountability
definition_mechanism: Assign risk oversight to an executive independent of core capability and product functions, with documented escalation
primary_implementer: frontier developer boards and regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Frontier-safety whistleblower protection
definition_mechanism: Protect employees reporting concealed risk, misleading safety claims or framework noncompliance and provide anonymous channels
primary_implementer: California Attorney General, courts and frontier developers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Staged access and release-modality governance
definition_mechanism: Begin with limited, vetted API access and expand only after monitoring; withhold downloadable weights where residual risk is unacceptable
primary_implementer: model provider under regulator oversight
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Risk-tiered API identity and campaign-account verification
definition_mechanism: Verify high-volume or high-risk customers, beneficial ownership and resellers; retain privacy-preserving attribution records
primary_implementer: API and cloud providers with regulator oversight
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Technical enforcement for Article 5-qualified manipulative practices
definition_mechanism: Build classifiers, account controls, rate limits and escalation for uses that satisfy the Article 5 conjunctive test; do not encode a general prohibition on political persuasion.
primary_implementer: AI-system providers, market surveillance authorities and AI Office
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Frontier model-weight cybersecurity standard
definition_mechanism: Protect unreleased weights with least privilege, strong identity controls, hardened interfaces, encryption, confidential computing and exfiltration testing
primary_implementer: frontier developers, cloud providers and regulator
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Mandatory downstream model documentation
definition_mechanism: Provide integrators with current information on capabilities, limitations, intended uses, evaluation results and safeguard assumptions
primary_implementer: GPAI provider and downstream system provider
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Synthetic-output provenance and disclosure
definition_mechanism: Embed robust, interoperable and detectable markers in generated text, audio, image and video, with visible labels for covered content
primary_implementer: generative-AI providers, deployers and standards bodies
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Long-horizon agency and dependency monitoring
definition_mechanism: Audit persistent memory, repeated recommendations, emotional cues, reliance and preference drift over extended interactions
primary_implementer: providers, independent researchers and regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Threshold-triggered notification for GPAI systemic-risk classification
definition_mechanism: Notify the Commission without delay and within two weeks when Article 51 high-impact capability is met or expected to be met; do not treat this as general pre-training notification.
primary_implementer: GPAI provider and AI Office
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Regulator model-access, evaluation, mitigation and recall powers
definition_mechanism: Allow the regulator to demand information, run evaluations, order mitigations and withdraw or recall a non-compliant model
primary_implementer: European AI Office
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Rights, democracy and agency impact assessment
definition_mechanism: Assess scale, scope, likelihood, reversibility and stakeholder impacts on autonomy, opinion formation and democratic processes
primary_implementer: states, providers, public authorities and independent assessors
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: International frontier-risk reporting framework
definition_mechanism: Standardise voluntary disclosures on risk identification, evaluation, incident management, security and transparency across providers
primary_implementer: OECD, G7 governments and advanced-AI developers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Security assessment and algorithm filing for socially mobilising generative AI
definition_mechanism: Require security assessment, algorithm filing and regulatory cooperation for services with public-opinion or social-mobilisation capacity
primary_implementer: Cyberspace Administration of China and sector regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: AI market concentration and structural oversight
definition_mechanism: Scrutinise equity, exclusivity, control, information sharing, compute commitments and preferential distribution in AI partnerships
primary_implementer: competition authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Interoperability, portability and exit
definition_mechanism: Reduce egress barriers, support model switching and multi-provider interfaces, and prevent self-preferencing or coercive tying
primary_implementer: competition authorities, public procurers and standards bodies
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Public-interest compute and AI infrastructure
definition_mechanism: Fund public compute capacity for evaluators, academia, civil society and public-interest model development
primary_implementer: governments, universities and AI safety institutes
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Platform election-risk assessment and implementation
definition_mechanism: Require VLOPs and VLOSEs to assess election-specific risks from service design, ranking, advertising, generative AI, coordinated manipulation and local context; deploy mitigations before the electoral period, maintain an incident mechanism and publish a post-election review.
primary_implementer: VLOPs and VLOSEs; supervised by the European Commission and Digital Services Coordinators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Recommender-system transparency for online platforms
definition_mechanism: Disclose in clear language the main recommender parameters and users' options to modify or influence them under DSA Article 27. The non-profiling option is coded separately under I-084.
primary_implementer: Online platforms and VLOPs; enforced by Digital Services Coordinators and the European Commission
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Dark patterns and unfair personalization
definition_mechanism: Prohibit online-platform interfaces that deceive, manipulate, or materially distort users' ability to make free and informed decisions.
primary_implementer: Online platforms; national Digital Services Coordinators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Political-ad transparency, targeting and repositories
definition_mechanism: Identify advertisements and sponsors, disclose key targeting parameters, and prohibit ad profiling using special-category data under DSA Article 26. The DSA Article 39 repository is VLOP/VLOSE-only; the broader political-ad repository is coded under P4-049.
primary_implementer: Online platforms and VLOPs
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Independent evaluation and researcher access
definition_mechanism: Give qualified external evaluators timely access to the strongest model, relevant internals and the version with the fewest safeguards
primary_implementer: AI Office, providers and accredited evaluators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Annual independent audits of systemic-risk and code commitments
definition_mechanism: Require annual independent audits of VLOP/VLOSE compliance, including risk controls and, for adherents, auditable Code of Conduct on Disinformation commitments.
primary_implementer: Independent audit organisations, platforms and European Commission
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Synthetic impersonation and authenticity controls
definition_mechanism: Apply TCPA consent and identification rules to AI-generated or cloned voices classified as artificial or prerecorded voices, subject to statutory exemptions.
primary_implementer: FCC, state attorneys general and telecom providers
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Auditable platform commitments on demonetisation, bots, fake accounts, impersonation, deepfakes and recommender integrity
definition_mechanism: Commit signatories to cut disinformation revenue, label and archive political ads, detect fake accounts and bot amplification, address impersonation and malicious deepfakes, support fact-checkers, improve recommender transparency and report service-level indicators.
primary_implementer: Adhering platforms, search engines, advertising actors, fact-checkers and civil society; overseen by Commission and Digital Services Board
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Election rapid response and escalation
definition_mechanism: Allow authorised non-platform signatories, fact-checkers and civil society to rapidly flag severe, time-sensitive content, accounts or trends and discuss response with platforms under their policies.
primary_implementer: EDMO, fact-checkers, civil society signatories and participating platforms
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: European Centre for Democratic Resilience and reinforced election coordination
definition_mechanism: Pool Member State, EU and civil-society expertise to anticipate, detect and respond to FIMI and disinformation; connect election networks, DSA data access, political-ad data and operational response.
primary_implementer: European Commission, participating Member States, candidate countries, EU bodies and stakeholder platform
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Mandatory digital imprints on paid political material and specified organic campaign material
definition_mechanism: Require covered digital material, including social posts, online ads, podcasts and publicly distributed messaging-app content, to state who promoted and on whose behalf it was published.
primary_implementer: Campaigners, candidates, parties, police and Electoral Commission
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Systemic platform duties for criminal foreign-interference content
definition_mechanism: Treat the National Security Act foreign-interference offence as a priority offence, requiring in-scope services to assess risk, prevent users encountering illegal material and minimise its availability; Ofcom can impose major fines and disruption measures.
primary_implementer: Online services and Ofcom, with police and national-security bodies
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Election-authority deepfake detection and impact-monitoring pilot
definition_mechanism: Monitor online audio and video for false candidate depictions or election-process claims, track reach, coordinate corrections or requested takedowns, and refer serious content to police or other bodies.
primary_implementer: UK Electoral Commission and ACE, with parties, candidates, platforms and police
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Human-rights and democratic-risk assessment
definition_mechanism: Require or encourage platforms to perform an election-cycle risk assessment, engage election administrators and civil society, assess design changes and take enhanced measures during elections and crises.
primary_implementer: States, independent regulators and digital platforms
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Political-party code for ethical digital campaigning and AI use
definition_mechanism: Secure public commitments by parties not to create, use or disseminate deceptive synthetic content or manipulative campaign techniques, to label AI use, protect cybersecurity and disclose campaign practices.
primary_implementer: Political parties, with election bodies and civil-society monitoring
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Messaging friction and mass-contact constraints
definition_mechanism: Limit forwarding to five chats and restrict already or highly forwarded messages to one chat at a time, while attaching forwarded labels.
primary_implementer: WhatsApp/Meta
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Technique-based prebunking and election media literacy
definition_mechanism: Expose voters in advance to short examples of manipulation techniques such as emotional manipulation, false dichotomies, scapegoating, incoherence and impersonation so they recognise tactics before encountering campaign content.
primary_implementer: Election authorities, educators, media, civil society and platforms
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Platform political-ad authorisation, archive, AI disclosure and final-week ad freeze
definition_mechanism: Verify political advertisers, archive ads, require self-disclosure for realistic AI-created or altered political ads, add labels and bar new US political ads during the final week when rebuttal time is short.
primary_implementer: Meta
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Ban on chatbots or avatars simulating conversation with a candidate or real person
definition_mechanism: Permit campaign chatbots, avatars and synthetic intermediaries only with disclosure and prohibit simulation of direct interlocution with a candidate or another real person.
primary_implementer: Campaigns, parties, AI-service providers and Electoral Justice
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Assistant anti-favoritism, loyalty and pluralism
definition_mechanism: Prohibit covered AI systems from ranking, recommending or prioritizing electoral actors, expressing electoral preference, recommending a vote, or directly or indirectly favoring or disfavoring them.
primary_implementer: Providers of internet applications offering AI systems; Electoral Justice
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Immediate de-amplification, evidence preservation and narrowly bounded corrective promotion
definition_mechanism: Require covered platforms to stop unlawful boosting or access, investigate involved accounts and preserve evidence; a same-form-and-reach corrective order is limited to false or severely decontextualised content that was irregularly boosted.
primary_implementer: Platforms and Electoral Justice
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Electoral data-protection duties for profiling and microtargeting
definition_mechanism: Require legal basis, purpose limitation, access and rights information, records of processing, security and incident reporting; make profiling for electoral microtargeting transparent; require specific, express and prominent consent for sensitive data and public high-risk impact reports when requested.
primary_implementer: Candidates, parties, coalitions, vendors, ANPD and Electoral Justice
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Prohibit materially harmful AI manipulation and exploitation
definition_mechanism: Ban AI systems using subliminal, purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques, or exploiting specified vulnerabilities, where behavior is materially distorted and significant harm results or is likely.
primary_implementer: EU AI Office and national market-surveillance authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Require a non-profiling recommender option
definition_mechanism: Require VLOPs and VLOSEs to offer at least one recommender option not based on GDPR profiling.
primary_implementer: European Commission
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Assistant memory, portability and deletion
definition_mechanism: Treat stored conversations, profiles, inferred preferences and memory as accountable personal-data processing.
primary_implementer: Controllers, processors and data-protection authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Provide complaints, investigation and remedial routes under the AI Act
definition_mechanism: Allow natural and legal persons to complain and empower authorities to inspect documentation, data and source code and order corrective measures.
primary_implementer: AI Office and national market-surveillance authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Mandate independent annual audits of very large platforms
definition_mechanism: Require independent audits of DSA obligations, including systemic-risk assessment and mitigation.
primary_implementer: Independent auditors under Commission oversight
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Protect and operationalize insider reporting on platform algorithmic practices
definition_mechanism: Provide an anonymous channel for insiders to report possible DSA violations involving recommender systems, advertising, risk assessment, civic discourse and children.
primary_implementer: European Commission and national authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Protect autonomy, democratic processes and free opinion formation throughout the AI lifecycle
definition_mechanism: Require parties to protect dignity, autonomy, democratic processes, transparency, accountability, remedies and lifecycle risk management.
primary_implementer: Ratifying states and domestic authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Protect media pluralism and regulated media visibility on dominant platforms
definition_mechanism: Create safeguards for recognized media providers against arbitrary platform restrictions and require media-market concentration assessment.
primary_implementer: European Commission, European Board for Media Services and national regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Public-sector AI registers, impact assessment and procurement
definition_mechanism: Require an independently audited AI management system with risk ownership, lifecycle controls, monitoring and continual improvement
primary_implementer: public procurers, regulators and accredited certification bodies
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Build an in-house public technical inspection authority
definition_mechanism: Give a public interdisciplinary body the expertise to inspect algorithms, test systems, support data access and measure systemic effects.
primary_implementer: European Centre for Algorithmic Transparency
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Freedom of thought, authorization and pluralistic civic AI
definition_mechanism: Apply binding freedom-of-thought, privacy and expression rights where relevant; separately test the emerging AI-specific interpretation using concealment, consent, power asymmetry, vulnerability and deliberative impairment.
primary_implementer: Legislatures, courts, human-rights institutions and AI regulators
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.

family_name: Apply AI Act high-risk controls to systems intended to influence elections or voting behaviour
definition_mechanism: Classify AI systems whose intended purpose is to influence an election or referendum outcome or voting behaviour as high-risk and apply lifecycle risk, documentation, logging, transparency, oversight, accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity duties when the timetable applies.
primary_implementer: Providers, deployers and market-surveillance authorities
notes: Family groups distinct implementations; it is not a policy ranking.
